name: interop-basic
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
printf 'alpha\n' > a.txt && mkdir -p dir/sub && printf 'beta\n' > dir/sub/b.txt &&
printf 'run\n' > run.sh && chmod +x run.sh && ln -s a.txt link.txt &&
printf '*.log\n' > .gitignore &&
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m 'initial import' &&
printf 'alpha2\n' >> a.txt && git add a.txt &&
GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112912000 +0000' git commit -q -m 'second commit' &&
git tag -a v1.0 -m 'release 1.0' && git tag light HEAD~1 &&
git branch topic HEAD~1
probes: git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/clone 2>&1; echo exit=$?; git -C @WORK@/clone log --format='%H %s'; git -C @WORK@/clone status --porcelain; git -C @WORK@/clone fsck; echo fsck=$?

name: interop-names
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
mkdir -p 'dir with space/inner' &&
printf '1\n' > 'dir with space/inner/file one' &&
printf '2\n' > 'quote"name' &&
printf '3\n' > 'utf8-\303\244\303\266' &&
printf '4\n' > empty && : > truly-empty &&
mkdir -p nested/a/b/c/d && printf '5\n' > nested/a/b/c/d/deep &&
git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m 'unusual names'
probes: git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/clone 2>&1; echo exit=$?; git -C @WORK@/clone log --format='%H %s'; git -C @WORK@/clone status --porcelain; git -C @WORK@/clone fsck; echo fsck=$?

name: interop-packed-repo
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8; do
  printf 'line %s\n' $(seq 1 $((i * 40))) > big$i.txt
  printf 'small %s\n' "$i" > s$i.txt
  mkdir -p d$i/sub && printf 'nested %s\n' "$i" > d$i/sub/n.txt
  git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m "commit $i"
done &&
git tag -a v1.0 -m 'release 1.0' && git tag light HEAD~3 &&
git branch topic HEAD~2 &&
git repack -a -d &&
git pack-refs --all
probes: for p in @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/*.idx; do git verify-pack -v "$p" > @WORK@/vp.txt; echo verify=$?; awk '$2 ~ /^(blob|commit|tag|tree)$/ {print $2}' @WORK@/vp.txt | sort | uniq -c; done
for p in @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/*.pack; do git index-pack --strict -o @WORK@/copy.idx "$p" >/dev/null && echo idx-ok; done
git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/clone1 && git --git-dir=@WORK@/clone1/.git fsck --strict && git --git-dir=@WORK@/clone1/.git log --format='%H %s' | head -3; echo exit=$?
git clone -q --no-local @REPO@ @WORK@/clone2 && git --git-dir=@WORK@/clone2/.git rev-list --all --count; echo exit=$?
git clone -q --bare @REPO@ @WORK@/bare.git && git --git-dir=@WORK@/bare.git show-ref | sort; echo exit=$?

mkdir -p @WORK@/unp && cd @WORK@/unp && git init -q . && for p in @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/*.pack; do git unpack-objects < "$p" >/dev/null; done && git cat-file --batch-all-objects --batch-check | sort | wc -l

name: interop-multi-pack
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
printf 'one\n' > a.txt && git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m first &&
git repack -a -d &&
printf 'two\n' > b.txt && git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m second &&
git repack -d &&
printf 'three\n' > c.txt && git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m third &&
git gc -q --no-prune 2>/dev/null || git repack -d
probes: git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/c && git --git-dir=@WORK@/c/.git fsck --strict; echo exit=$?
git --git-dir=@REPO@/.git repack -a -d >/dev/null 2>&1; git --git-dir=@REPO@/.git fsck --strict; echo repacked=$?

name: interop-deltified-pack
build:
git init -q -b main . &&
seq 1 400 > base.txt && git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m base &&
for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do
  seq 1 $((400 + i * 3)) > base.txt
  git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m "grow $i"
done &&
git repack -a -d -f --window=50 --depth=20
probes: for p in @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/*.idx; do git verify-pack -s "$p" >/dev/null && echo stat-ok; done
for p in @REPO@/.git/objects/pack/*.pack; do git index-pack --strict -o @WORK@/d.idx "$p" >/dev/null && echo idx-ok; done
git clone -q @REPO@ @WORK@/c && cd @WORK@/c && git log --format='%H %s' | tail -2 && md5sum base.txt; echo exit=$?

name: interop-push-into-us
probes: git init -q @WORK@/src && cd @WORK@/src && printf 'x\n' > x.txt && git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m pushed && git branch -M main && git push -q @REPO@ main 2>&1; echo exit=$?

cd @WORK@/src && printf 'y\n' > y.txt && git add -A && GIT_AUTHOR_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' GIT_COMMITTER_DATE='@1112911993 +0000' git commit -q -m second && git push @REPO@ main 2>&1 | sed 's/[0-9a-f]\{7,40\}/OID/g'; echo exit=$?

build:

for i in 1 2 3 4; do
  seq 1 $((i * 40)) > f$i.txt
  mkdir -p d$i && printf 'nested %s\n' "$i" > d$i/n.txt

done &&
git tag -a v1 -m release && git branch topic HEAD~1 &&
git config uploadpack.allowFilter true &&
git repack -a -d
probes: git -c protocol.version=2 clone -q --no-local --upload-pack="@EXEC@/git-upload-pack" @REPO@ @WORK@/c1 && git --git-dir=@WORK@/c1/.git fsck --strict && git --git-dir=@WORK@/c1/.git log --format='%H %s' | head -2; echo exit=$?

git init -q @WORK@/f1 && git -C @WORK@/f1 -c protocol.version=2 fetch -q --upload-pack="@EXEC@/git-upload-pack" @REPO@ 'refs/heads/*:refs/remotes/o/*' && git -C @WORK@/f1 for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' | sort; echo exit=$?

test "$(git --git-dir=@WORK@/c1/.git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git --git-dir=@WORK@/c0/.git rev-parse HEAD)" && echo 'v0 and v2 clones agree'
